name: Sathiyavanimuthu Ammaiyar Ninaivu Free Supply of Sewing Machine Scheme
benefit: Sewing machines and accessories are provided at free of cost.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed ₹72,000/-.
1. The age of the applicant should be between 20 to 40 years.
1. The applicant should have knowledge of tailoring.
1. The applicant should be ANY ONE of the following:

- Destitute Woman.
- Widow.
- Deserted Woman.
- Differently Abled Man.
- Differently Abled Woman.
- Socially Affected Woman.
- Woman From Economically Weaker Sections.
